latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor Hindi 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Easily edit Hindi videos using AI by uploading raw footage and describing desired edits (e.g., add Hindi subtitles, trim pauses, add background music).
- Automatic setup and connection to a cloud backend; provides 100 free credits on first use.
- Simple prompt-based workflow: upload, edit, and export high-quality 1080p MP4 videos.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Built-in error handling for unsupported files, token issues, rate limits, and more.
